_comment: Function bodies gas-lint's second-copy check lets stand in two files, each with why (CLAUDE.md, "Keeping debt down": the second copy moves to one place). An entry lists the copies as "<file basename>:<function>"; one that no longer matches a pair is an error, so this list can't outlive its reason.

allow.why: It calls Session.getScriptTimeZone(), and 00 (the shared place) is in two projects without the userinfo.email scope Session needs (structure audit 3.5); the two dashboards are separate projects.
Client code in two separate web apps' pages; a shared include was judged not worth it for ~31 identical lines while the rest of their client code has drifted (structure audit 4.5).
